title: Taylor hospitalized with injuries from ranch phenomena

tellings.quote: He had to go to the hospital because of injuries and he's had things happen that have followed him.

plain: A man named Travis Taylor is said to have ended up in hospital with injuries from the strange happenings at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of unexplained events. The ranch's owner tells Michels this, adding that Taylor has had things happen to him that have "followed him" away from the ranch. If true, it would mean whatever is going on there can do real harm and does not stay in one place.
